command: powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "`$projects=@('CampusNetwork_02','CampusNetwork_03','CampusNetwork_04','CampusNetwork_05','CampusNetwork_06','CampusNetwork_07','CampusNetwork_08','CampusNetwork_09','CampusNetwork-for-perf'); `$nodes=@('AGG_SW_04','Core_SW_01','Core_SW_02','FW_01','FW_02','BJHQ_CSR1000V_GW_01','PE1','PE3','SZ_AR','SZ_Core','SZ_Server_Cluster3'); foreach(`$n in `$nodes){ Write-Output ('NODE='+`$n); foreach(`$p in `$projects){ `$u='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/'+`$p+'/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd=display%20current-configuration'; try{`$o=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u -Method Get).output; Write-Output (`$p+'|'+`$o.Length+'|'+`$o.GetHashCode())}catch{Write-Output (`$p+'|ERR')}}}"
